name: svf
summary: Chamberlin state-variable filter with a selectable output (LP/BP/HP), a bypass, and a cutoff envelope. `f` = 2*sin(pi*fc/fs) (Q16), `q` = damping (Q16), `type` 0=LP 1=BP 2=HP picks `out`, `on` 0 = bypass (out = input), `fenv` (control, Q15) scales `fenv_depth` (Q16) and is added to `f`, so a note-gated envelope opens/closes the cutoff. Bipolar `k` (key-follow) and `vk` (velocity-follow) factors (Q15) push `f` toward 0/65535 (block-derived `f_eff`). The combined cutoff `fc = clamp16(f_eff + fenv_depth·fenv)` is block-derived (all its inputs are block-rate), so it is computed once per block, and it is a state field, so two `svf` instances don't collide on a hardcoded local.
